metric_semantics.edge_auroc_edge_ap: candidate_edge_scores_and_labels receives continuous edge scores and candidate_edge_mask, then compute_edge_ground_truth_metrics computes AUROC/AP over the full candidate-edge set without thresholding.
metric_semantics.fid_minus: 1 when retaining only selected edges changes original prediction, else 0.
metric_semantics.fid_plus: 1 when removing selected edges changes original prediction, else 0.
metric_semantics.probability_reference_class: All probabilities are softmax probabilities of the original predicted class.
metric_semantics.retain_probability: softmax probability of original predicted class on retain-only graph.
metric_semantics.retain_probability_ratio: retain_probability / original_probability when original_probability != 0.0, otherwise None. No epsilon or clipping is used.

random_aggregation_explanation: Random raw seed rows are preserved. The primary Random quality table first averages each metric across seeds 0..9 inside each node_id, then summarizes the 167 node-level means across nodes. Edge AUROC/AP can match across backbones because they depend on the same candidate/GT/random scores. Perturbation metrics can differ because predictions after edge removal or retention are computed by each frozen backbone.
